real_defects.issue: flightTime and reachesSpeedBetweenStops assumed v >= a^2/j. For a slow lift (0.5 m/s, a=j=1) the car reaches rated speed before full acceleration, so flight time was overstated (0.75 m: 3.00 s vs 2.914 s integrated), jumped at the regime boundary, and the 'reaches rated speed' flag said no for hops between 0.707 and 0.75 m. Fix: cap peak acceleration at sqrt(vj) in one shared ratedSpeedDistance helper. RTT effect about 0.4% on a 4-floor 0.5 m/s building; published bench rows (v >= 1.6) unchanged.

normalise() on a loaded JSON file with a null or non-object floor threw a raw TypeError ('Cannot read properties of null'), shown verbatim on the page. Fix: refuse with 'floor N must have a rise and a population'.
